# Snap-Fit Strain

Bending strain at a snap-fit's root as it is pushed home.

<figure markdown="span">
![Snap-Fit Strain: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-snap-fit-strain-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Snap-Fit Strain: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-snap-fit-strain-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Bending strain at a snap-fit's root as it clears its catch, against the material's permissible strain.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | High |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 1.2% strain at the root | 2.0% strain at the root | Aim for: Engineering judgement, [Covestro (formerly Bayer MaterialScience)](../../citations/bibliography.md#covestro-snap-fit "About 60% of the limit, for snaps opened often")<br>At most: <abbr title="A conservative placeholder: set each material from its supplier's data">Engineering judgement</abbr> |
| PA | 2.4% strain at the root | 4.0% strain at the root | Aim for: Derived, [Covestro (formerly Bayer MaterialScience)](../../citations/bibliography.md#covestro-snap-fit "About 60% of the limit, for snaps opened often")<br>At most: Published, [Bayer MaterialScience](../../citations/bibliography.md#bayer-part-mold-design "Durethan PA, dry: 4% (6% conditioned)") |
| PC | 2.4% strain at the root | 4.0% strain at the root | Aim for: Derived, [Covestro (formerly Bayer MaterialScience)](../../citations/bibliography.md#covestro-snap-fit "About 60% of the limit, for snaps opened often")<br>At most: Published, [Covestro (formerly Bayer MaterialScience)](../../citations/bibliography.md#covestro-snap-fit "Makrolon PC: 4%") |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    High Snap-Fit Strain (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, straining its root past `{target}`, the limit for a snap that is opened and closed often. Lengthen or thin the beam, taper it to half its thickness at the hook, or reduce the catch.
!!! failure "Error"

    Snap-Fit Overstrained (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, straining its root past `{limit}`, more than the material takes even once. It will whiten, take a set or break as it is assembled. Lengthen or thin the beam, taper it to half its thickness at the hook, or reduce the catch.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
